steps.title: Initialize YouTube Home Architecture
steps.description: Setup project configuration, permissions, package definitions, and application manifest metadata.

steps.title: Configure Audio & Microphone Permissions
steps.description: Declare RECORD_AUDIO and MODIFY_AUDIO_SETTINGS permissions in AndroidManifest.xml and add speech recognition queries for Android 11+.

steps.title: Design Application Layout with Mic & Search Bar
steps.description: Add interactive search bar input with voice microphone button for keyboard speech typing and instant voice search.

steps.title: Design Download Manager Dialog Layouts
steps.description: Build layout files for managing active downloads list and custom item layout.

steps.title: Implement Download Models and Data Adapters
steps.description: Create DownloadItem data object and DownloadAdapter for managing downloaded media entries.

steps.title: Implement Web Engine and Microphone Permissions Handler
steps.description: Integrate WebChromeClient.onPermissionRequest to grant audio capture resources to YouTube Web UI.

steps.title: Implement Voice Speech Recognition & Keyboard Mic Input
steps.description: Add Android RecognizerIntent speech input triggered by Mic button and keyboard voice typing to populate search input.

steps.title: Implement File Upload Integration
steps.description: Add support for WebChromeClient.onShowFileChooser to handle uploading video files, audio, and images.

steps.title: Implement Background File Download Listener
steps.description: Integrate DownloadListener with native DownloadManager for downloading videos and media directly to storage.

steps.title: Implement Fullscreen Video Playback Container
steps.description: Add support for full-screen HTML5 video rendering with WebChromeClient custom view handlers.

steps.title: Final Verification & Build
steps.description: Verify microphone runtime permission checks, speech recognition fallback, and runtime compatibility.

steps.title: Building youtube Home
steps.description: Assemble and package the complete Android application binary.
